title: Architecture rules
description: Layer direction, slice, cycle, role and level rules driven by .frontsmith/architecture.json.

rules.title: Import violates allowed layer direction
rules.message: The import goes against the allowed layer direction.
rules.fix: Move the shared code down, or invert the dependency through a port.
rules.rationale: Layer direction keeps low-level code independent of high-level code.

rules.title: Cross-slice import within one sliced layer
rules.message: A slice imports another slice of the same layer.
rules.fix: Lift the shared part into a lower layer.
rules.rationale: Slices must stay independent so they can change and ship separately.

rules.title: Deep import bypasses a slice public API
rules.message: The import reaches inside another slice instead of using its public API.
rules.fix: Import from the slice index file and export what is needed there.
rules.rationale: Deep imports freeze a slice's internal structure.

rules.title: Import cycle
rules.message: The file is part of an import cycle.
rules.fix: Break the cycle by extracting the shared part or inverting a dependency.
rules.rationale: Cycles make initialisation order fragile and block independent change.

rules.title: Presentational component imports data, state or service modules
rules.message: A presentational component imports data, state or service code.
rules.fix: Pass data and callbacks through props from a container.
rules.rationale: Presentational components stay reusable and easy to test when they do not fetch or own state.

rules.title: Atomic level imports a higher level
rules.fix: Move the shared piece down to the lower level.
rules.rationale: Each atomic level may only build on lower ones.

rules.title: Source file not mapped to any layer
rules.message: The file belongs to no architecture layer.
rules.fix: Map its directory to a layer, or ignore it explicitly in architecture.json.
rules.rationale: Unmapped code escapes every dependency rule.
